original_query: Which part of the organ, the Inflammation of which is called Appendicitis, shows the Signs/symptoms of Diarrhoea and crampy pain?

summaries.found_via_query: Anatomy of the appendix and symptoms of appendicitis including diarrhea and crampy pain
summaries.summary: The page details atypical presentations of appendicitis, listing different locations of the appendix and their associated signs/symptoms. It includes a diagram of the appendix with labeled regions such as anterior, posterior, retrocecal, paracecal, pelvic, and subcecal. The table indicates that 'Retro/paraleal' location is associated with diarrhea and crampy pain.
key_facts: Retro/paraleal location of appendix presents with diarrhea and crampy pain
McBurney's point shows typical presentation and Rovsig sign
Retro/paracaecal location shows Psoas sign/flank pain and absence of peritonism
Pelvic location shows suprapubic pain, urinary frequency, and pyuria
